import inspect
import os
from pathlib import Path
from click.utils import format_filename

assert inspect.signature(format_filename).parameters['normalize_slashes'].kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
for value in [r'a\b\c.txt', b'a\\b\\c.txt', Path(r'a\b\c.txt'), b'a\\\xff.txt', 'a\\\udcff.txt']:
    for shorten in (False, True):
        raw = os.path.basename(value) if shorten else os.fspath(value)
        expected = raw.decode(__import__('sys').getfilesystemencoding(), 'replace') if isinstance(raw, bytes) else raw.encode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape').decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        assert format_filename(value, shorten) == expected
        assert format_filename(value, shorten, normalize_slashes=False) == expected
        assert format_filename(value, shorten, normalize_slashes=True) == expected.replace('\\', '/')

arguments.command:
@'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(r'src\click\utils.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/utils.py'])
print('original CRLF', original.count(b'\r\n'), 'LF', original.count(b'\n'))
old_lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
new_lines = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
import difflib
result = []
for tag, i, j, a, b in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [s.rstrip(b'\r\n') for s in old_lines], [s.rstrip(b'\r\n') for s in new_lines], autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if tag == 'equal':
        result.extend(old_lines[i:j])
    else:
        result.extend(new_lines[a:b])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -B -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat
